_metadata.description: Requirements for CLI, UI, Test Genie integration, and self-audit workflows.

requirements.title: Expose thin CLI commands over the API
requirements.description: The CLI declares audit, contracts list, explain, and fix-config commands and keeps parsing/formatting separate from quality policy logic.

validation.notes: Run quality-health command help, JSON output tests, and cli-health discoverability checks once commands are implemented.

requirements.title: Provide operator audit UI
requirements.description: The UI renders the API audit model with scenario overview, surface breakdown, findings workbench, contract details, and autofix preview states.

validation.notes: Vitest/RTL and smoke/BAS coverage for loading, empty, error, degraded, and populated audit states.

requirements.title: Power the Test Genie quality phase
requirements.description: Test Genie delegates the `quality` phase to Quality Health and stops running duplicate native lint/type or Tidiness Manager type-safety producers.

validation.notes: Run `test-genie execute quality-health --phases quality --json` and Test Genie scenario tests after the cutover phase.

requirements.title: Audit Quality Health itself
requirements.description: Quality Health can audit its own generated React/Vite, Go API, Go CLI, Makefile, and testing metadata surfaces and produce truthful findings.

validation.notes: Run `quality-health audit quality-health --json` and `vrooli scenario test quality-health` after API/CLI implementation.
